name: COMO Parrot Cay, Turks & Caicos
positioning: Private-island beach retreat across 1,000 acres in the Turks and Caicos, with private-pool beach houses and villas and one of the first COMO Shambhala wellness retreats
best_for: Families who want a beach house or villa with its own pool and a kids' programme
Wellness-focused travelers drawn to COMO Shambhala's holistic therapies, yoga and Pilates
Travelers who want island nature: mangrove kayaking, biking trails, diving and boat trips

facts.text: COMO Parrot Cay is a private island retreat set across 1,000 acres in the Turks and Caicos.
The island is reached from Providenciales airport by a 15-minute drive followed by a 35-minute boat ride, about 50 minutes in total.
The resort was designed by British interior decorator Keith Hobbs, combining a relaxed beach house aesthetic with a contemporary style.
The wellness centre at COMO Parrot Cay was one of the first COMO Shambhala Retreats.
The spa specialises in Asian-inspired holistic therapies, including reflexology.
The spa has an infinity pool and sundeck.
COMO Beach Club has direct beach access, two pools, daybeds and towels.
Complimentary bikes can be used on trails through tropical forests and coconut and banana plantations.
Dive certification courses are offered in partnership with Big Blue on request.
Guests have access to tennis courts, running trails and the coconut and banana grove.
Poolside Lotus serves light Caribbean-inspired dishes by day and contemporary Asian cuisine by night, while Terrace specialises in modern Italian cuisine.
Play by COMO is the resort's nature-inspired kids' programme.

highlights.text: Every beach house, villa and multi-room Residence has its own private pool and direct beach access.
COMO Shambhala has treatment pavilions overlooking the North Caicos Channel, a yoga pavilion, a Pilates studio and a Jacuzzi garden.
Guides lead kayak trips into the island's mangrove forest, home to wildlife including turtles, herons and egrets.
Private boat charters can be used for whale watching for migrating humpbacks in the winter months.

considerations.text: Getting there takes a drive from Providenciales airport and then a boat ride, about 50 minutes in total.
COMO Butler service is offered in Beach Houses and higher accommodation categories, not in other room types.
Laundry is offered but there is no dry cleaning.
